items.title: Brand's barrister refers himself to regulator after report he confronted journalist
items.summary: Ian Winter allegedly confronted a reporter outside court who had investigated the comedian.

items.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
items.summary: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.

items.title: 'Misleading' student loans information left out examples of higher-salary repayments
items.summary: The Treasury Committee chair says she is "shocked" after one university compared repayments to the price of coffee.

items.title: Armed police called after boy hurt near Gloucester school
items.summary: Two schools went into lockdown following the incident and one woman has been arrested.

items.title: Childminder who left more than 20 children alone in her home jailed
items.summary: Amanda Mathewson was caught neglecting children at her home in Dunfermline after being spied on by parents.

items.title: Watch: Is it the end of the road for Tesla's Cybertruck?
items.summary: The car company's CEO Elon Musk has said production will halt in Texas, to focus on the firm's self-driving Cybercabs.

items.title: Met chief says he wouldn't be surprised if more allegations made about Brand after rape conviction
items.summary: Sir Mark Rowley tells the BBC that what he heard reported from Brand's trial came close to "victim blaming".

items.title: How 2000s lad culture helped Russell Brand to hide in plain sight
items.summary: The behaviour that formed the backdrop to Brand's prosecution also helped elevate him, writes the BBC's media editor Katie Razzall.
